allow: PowerShell($cmds = 'vercel','netlify','gh','firebase','wrangler'; foreach \($c in $cmds\) { $found = Get-Command $c -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($found\) { "$c : $\($found.Source\)" } else { "$c : not installed" } })

PowerShell($p = Start-Process npm -ArgumentList 'run','preview' -PassThru -WindowStyle Hidden; Start-Sleep -Seconds 4; try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'http://localhost:4173/' -UseBasicParsing; "HTTP $\($r.StatusCode\), $\($r.Content.Length\) bytes" } catch { "FAILED: $_" } finally { Stop-Process -Id $p.Id -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Get-Process node -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.StartTime -gt \(Get-Date\).AddSeconds\(-10\) } | Stop-Process -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue })
